title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by selecting products mentioned in the five sources (Consumer Reports, PCMag, CNET, Reviewed.com, TechGearLab, Bon Appétit). Products cited by more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Where a source gave a price it is shown; otherwise price is null. No external pricing was added.
